verdict.rationale: Card issuance is a fair axis for a travel-and-expense platform, so it applies. The pack only shows that Navan card transactions exist, that the MCP can view card status and how many cards a user has, and that existing corporate cards can be connected. Nothing documents issuing physical or virtual cards to team members, how fast that is, or setting a spend limit per card.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit
